routes.action: Register the four-identity photo-reconstruction handoff as Candidate: capture/pose evidence, uncompressed checkpoint, cleanup history and lossy delivery derivative.
routes.acceptance: Schema validates explicit coordinate frame, units/gauge, pose convention, trainer/viewer versions, SH degree, hashes and derivative relationship. Frozen R1 remains unchanged.

routes.action: Use any future splat only as a photo observation/reference overlay or presentation derivative. Do not replace semantic parts, topology, anchors, collision, articulation, material state, history or procedural regeneration.
routes.acceptance: One small static object shows a traceable link from photos to splat and separately to Object DNA; visual similarity alone is not adoption.

routes.action: For r186 trials, require SPZ v4/default RUB/no coordinate extension/SH<=3 and retain the float PLY baseline. Reject files that merely load while violating the capability profile.
routes.acceptance: Fixed-view PLY/SPZ comparison plus macOS and 390x844 iPhone/Safari load time, peak memory, frame time, sort artifacts and human acceptance are recorded separately.

routes.action: After a user photo set is supplied, run only one small static-object pilot through photo validation, COLMAP poses, Brush training, cleanup, PLY checkpoint, constrained SPZ and Three.js r186 viewing.
routes.acceptance: Reprojection/registration, metric anchor, source hashes, training config/seed, cleanup log, compression error and target-device evidence are complete before proposing broader use or RealityScan retirement.
